scenes.title: Eight chapters on the wall
scenes.copy: Canal iron → steel → Buhl gift → Amish neighbors → Friday lights → music → Youngstown 1970s → living valley.
scenes.narration: Welcome. I am David, regional historian for western Pennsylvania and eastern Ohio. Tonight we walk eight museum chapters — Context labeled, Evidence preferred. We begin at Buhl Farm Park.

scenes.title: Satellite from the hub
scenes.copy: Every pin radiates from Hermitage’s free green. Ohio sites sit minutes across the line.
scenes.narration: Open the satellite atlas. Buhl Farm is the hub — deeded in nineteen fifteen for one dollar, forever free. Youngstown appears because the border is a short drive.

scenes.title: Erie Extension — Lock Ten
scenes.copy: One hundred thirty-six miles, more than a hundred locks. Sharpsville keeps the surviving stone.
scenes.narration: Chapter one — canal iron. The Erie Extension climbed from the Ohio River to Lake Erie. Sharpsville’s Lock Ten is the remnant. Rail killed the boats; the lock remains.

scenes.title: Magic City — Farrell
scenes.copy: Buhl Steel eighteen ninety-six; South Sharon nineteen hundred; ten thousand jobs at the peak.
scenes.narration: Chapter two — steel. Frank Buhl’s plants and Farrell’s Magic City put the valley on the industrial map. Flip the first steel card — wall text, not romance.

scenes.title: Forever free
scenes.copy: Lake Julia, Casino, free nine-hole golf — still claimed unique in the United States.
scenes.narration: Chapter three — the gift. Frank and Julia preferred farm to park. No tickets. No midway. The endowment still keeps the green open.

scenes.title: Since eighteen forty-seven
scenes.copy: New Wilmington and Volant — Mifflin County roots, western Pennsylvania roads.
scenes.narration: Chapter four — neighbors. Old Order districts since eighteen forty-seven. Share the lane. Photograph fields, not faces.

scenes.title: Steel Bowl nights
scenes.copy: Sharon Tigers, Farrell Steelers — District 10 rivalry on a mill-town map.
scenes.narration: Chapter five — Friday lights. The Steel Bowl and the gyms stitch Sharon and Farrell. Buhl’s free fields came first.

scenes.title: Sharon harmony, Mercer County rock
scenes.copy: Butala / Lettermen; Reznor / Mercer High — same county, careful geography.
scenes.narration: Chapter six — music. Tony Butala from Sharon. Trent Reznor from Mercer borough. Keep the towns straight.

scenes.title: War and Black Monday
scenes.copy: Cleveland vs Pittsburgh for the bug; Sheet & Tube falls 19 September 1977.
scenes.narration: Chapter seven — Youngstown. Crime Town label, faction war, Charlie Carabbia vanishing, and Black Monday at Campbell Works. Same decade. Museum reading only.

scenes.title: Living valley
scenes.copy: Keep Buhl free. Ask David about any chapter on the wall.
scenes.narration: Closing chapter — living valley. The reel stops once through. Ask me anything about western Pennsylvania or eastern Ohio. Facts first.
